name: airquote
description: Turns voice-mode dictation into clean, clear prompts: detects which prompts you spoke, then has Haiku remove filler, apply self-corrections and (optionally) restructure them before Claude reads them.

mode.title: Rewrite mode
mode.description: enhance: clean up and restructure into a clearer prompt. clean: fix filler, punctuation and self-corrections only. off: never rewrite (Claude is still told the prompt was spoken).

model.title: Rewrite model
model.description: The Claude model that rewrites your dictation. haiku (default) is fastest. sonnet and opus can follow your extra instructions more closely but are slower (several seconds per prompt) and use more of your plan's usage.

dictionary.title: Personal dictionary
dictionary.description: Comma-separated terms the rewrite should spell exactly, e.g. project names, people, libraries.

instructions.title: Extra rewrite instructions
instructions.description: Your own guidance for how prompts should be rewritten, e.g. "keep my casual tone", "always end with: ask before editing files", "write in British English". Applied in clean and enhance modes.

attach_transcript.title: Attach original transcript
attach_transcript.description: When a prompt is rewritten, also give Claude your exact dictated words as hidden context, so it can check the rewrite against what you said. Off: Claude sees only the rewrite (and the note that it was spoken).

share_context.title: Share repo and conversation context
share_context.description: Send the repository's file list and the last few messages along with the dictation, so names and references come out right. Off: only the dictation and dictionary are sent.
